name: DSB
description: DSB's light greys, white cards and dark text, with its navy as the accent (Relaid keeps red for what destroys), in light and dark; small corners, a plain header and outlined cards. Start, Your trips, Departures and Profile as tabs with icons; Log in and a sheet's main button filled as the screen's action; a sheet's heading as its title; the departures search named in the app's own words.
